review.reviewer: current Codex assistant, candidate author and explicit source/algorithm reviewer
review.algorithm_assessment: Build one suffix automaton over all names separated by a character outside a-z. Every letter end position carries its source-name identity and the length available since the latest separator. Propagate end-position ownership through suffix links, using distinct states for no owner, one owner, and multiple owners. A state belonging to one name contributes the represented substring lengths above its suffix-link length, capped by a separator-free suffix length. This counts distinct substrings once, rejects shared substrings including duplicate names, and excludes all cross-name substrings.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
